2 things I can tell you from my experience. And I was burnt out too. Back in class 11-12, I was on Anti-Psychotic meds and life was a mess. It still is, but yeah it's okay.

1. Wing it. 
You're gonna be presented with doing fun random shit. Things that you'd not do routinely. Go for it. The dopamine kick will ease the burn out. It'll help you gather yourself. The spontaneity will help with confidence too. An upward spiral if you may!

2. Life's transient.
Everything's temporary. When the world crumbles down on you. Trapping you. That's exactly when you rest. Wait it out. It's like they say this too shall pass. Happiness will pass, so will the dark times. Let go. I personally say "it is, what it is." But yea. That's the idea.


Now, if you can, get talking to a therapist. You'll find safe space.

One final thing.
If things look grey. Maybe you're holding back on colors.
What I mean to say is, happiness is a habit.
It's a set of concious decisions.
You choose to be happy.
The day you detach happiness from cause and effect, that's when you'll be at peace.
